items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was in a class with George Owens when it comes to brushes and playing with a sextet. Taste. Ultimate. Fabulous. O'Neill Spencer was something else.

ctx.x: Charlie Shavers was in Tommy’s band for three years too. We were roommates. There was one of the greatest trumpet players that ever lived. Tommy Dorsey said he was – because he was not only a great trumpet player. He was a great piano player, great arranger, composer. Undecided. He wrote Undecided with the John Kirby Sextet: O’Neill Spencer, brushes . . .
Talk about O’Neill, because a lot of people don’t know about him.
He was in a class with George Owens when it comes to brushes and playing with a sextet. Taste. Ultimate. Fabulous. O’Neill Spencer was something else.
